title: Event Frequency Distribution
insights:
Analysis of Bus Ticket Booking App Dataset

The dataset contains a total of 14,985 events triggered by 14,985 users over a period from November 27, 2025 to February 19, 2026. There are 109 unique event types recorded.

Event Frequency Distribution

The top 20 events by frequency are as follows:

  • viewed_hisab_page: 5,361 events (35.78%)
  • viewed_hisab_bus_detail: 3,159 events (21.08%)
  • viewed_dashboard_page: 1,403 events (9.36%)
  • viewed_hisab_trip_detail: 1,275 events (8.51%)
  • clicked_hisab_trip_detail_card: 1,205 events (8.04%)
  • clicked_hisab_bus_detail_card: 1,141 events (7.61%)
  • clicked_nav_drawer_menu: 131 events (0.87%)
  • clicked_hisab_yestarday_btn: 125 events (0.83%)
  • dashboard_clicked_gps_vistar_se_dekhe_bus_card: 90 events (0.60%)
  • home_page_load_error: 88 events (0.59%)
  • clicked_hisab_coustom_date_btn: 60 events (0.40%)
  • clicked_login_send_otp_btn: 58 events (0.39%)
  • clicked_login_verify_otp: 43 events (0.29%)
  • clicked_hisab_today_btn: 43 events (0.29%)
  • viewed_login_page: 40 events (0.27%)
  • viewed_online_payment_history_page: 40 events (0.27%)
  • viewed_login/signup_page: 36 events (0.24%)
  • clicked_hisab_download_btn: 36 events (0.24%)
  • viewed_login_otp_verify_page: 36 events (0.24%)
  • clicked_manage_route_and_pricing_view_pricing_btn: 35 events (0.23%)

Analysis Findings

DOMINANT PATTERNS

The events that dominate the dataset are viewed_hisab_page and viewed_hisab_bus_detail, which together account for 56.86% of all events. This indicates that users primarily engage with the bus details and their account information. The high frequency of these events suggests that users are actively seeking information about their trips and bus options.

EVENT NOISE

There are no events that appear suspiciously often that would indicate a logging bug. However, several events have very low counts, such as viewed_login/signup_page and clicked_manage_route_and_pricing_view_pricing_btn, each with 36 and 35 occurrences respectively. These low counts may suggest that these features are either broken or not utilized by users, warranting further investigation.

POWER USERS

Power users, defined as those in the 90th percentile (P90+), show a median event count of 1, with both P90 and P99 also at 1. This indicates that even among the most engaged users, there is a low level of interaction with the app, suggesting a lack of deep engagement or a ceiling effect in user activity.

CONSOLIDATION

There are several event names that could potentially be consolidated, particularly those related to viewing bus details and trip details, such as viewed_hisab_trip_detail and viewed_hisab_bus_detail. Streamlining these events could simplify the dataset and provide clearer insights into user interactions.
